title: Backtracking Pattern
definition: Used when you need to generate all possible Permutations, Combinations, or Subsets. The pattern is: `choose -> explore -> unchoose`.
simpleExplanation: The brute-force way to generate every possible combination of something.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Backtracking Pattern.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Backtracking Pattern to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Backtracking Pattern into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Backtracking Pattern.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Backtracking Pattern from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
